messages:
Elaine CS: Quick heads up — Novara (retail) just told us they're running an org-wide proof-of-value. Want chat + embeddings + reranking across Merch, CX, and Returns teams. Flagging for potential dedicated capacity.

Sanjay AM: How big are they thinking? any rough numbers yet?

Elaine CS: Deck attached from the customer: https://redwood.internal/cs/novara-pov. Timeline = 6 week PoV. They expect to start small but add Merch (search UX), CX (help assistant), Returns (fraud triage). Early asks: embeddings for catalog, reranking for search, chat latency p95 target ~200ms for short answers.

Jess AE: Heads up that their renewal is June '25 — big upsell if PoV wins. We should prioritize enablement and a tight success criteria doc.

Mike Eng: Do we have token/embedding estimates? Also want to know if routes share a KV cache. If p95=200ms we'll probably need reserved pods or high-priority routing + quantized models.

Elaine CS: From their vendor sheet: `~120M tokens/mo` by month 3, `~50k embeddings/mo`. Peak morning traffic they'd like to support ~400 concurrent short-chat reqs. They called out SLOs and strict PII separation per team.

ops-bot: :rotating_light: Usage alert — Novara test workspace token usage +380% WoW during the pilot window. Monitoring for sustained growth.

Sanjay AM: Risk note: if performance/latency isn't predictable they may prototype on a major cloud AI endpoint. Action items: schedule tech onboarding + architecture review this week. I'll own the meeting invite and pre-work.

Mike Eng: I'll draft a recommended infra config: Dedicated pool (2x A10g equiv), autoscale with burst up to 4 nodes, enable prefix/KV caching for chat, and recommend int8 quant for the reranker model. Also propose route-level SLOs and fallback to lighter model for non-critical paths. Will post runbook.

Jess AE: I'll prepare a one-pager for execs showing ROI vs current search spend and tie success criteria to renewal metrics. Need example prompts and evaluation set from Novara.

Elaine CS: Can someone from Optimize look at model/quant recommendations and prepare a quick perf/cost comparison? Also need an onboarding checklist template and role-based playbook for Merch (engineering + PM + data).

Mike Eng: Draft config snippet I'm thinking of: ```Recommended stack:
- model: gpt-shop-v1-qa (quantized)
- reranker: rerank-r1 (int8)
- embeddings: embed-512
- embeddings batch size: 8
- cache TTL: 24h
- autoscale: base=2 nodes, burst=4 nodes
``` I'll attach perf estimates and cost delta.

Sanjay AM: Meeting scheduled Thu 10:00am PT — invite sent to Novara + internal pod (Elaine, Mike, Jess, Optimize lead). Pre-req: Novara to share sample prompts and catalog snapshot.

Elaine CS: :thumbsup: thanks team. I'll log enablement tasks in Gainsight and capture customer feedback during PoV. If we hit the projected numbers this becomes a clear multi-team expansion opportunity — treat as high priority for renewals and Dedicated sales motion.
